Name: Mako's Spam Mail
Author: MakoKZ
Description:
Ever felt like you didn't get enough mail in your mailbox? Well, now you can get more!

Spam Mail (currently) adds [s]23[/s] [s]28[/s] 29 new letters that can show up in your mailbox. Some have gifts attached, but don't expect anything super crazy. It's all just a bit of fun!

All letters currently have a 3-10% chance of showing up on any given day, and some won't show up until you've seen others in their series.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

Installation:
Unzip the file and place it into your Mods folder.

Config:
[b]Ominous Letters: [/b]Enabled by default, the mod currently has 2 letters that are more "ominous" in tone than "silly." Disable this to prevent them from showing up.

What to expect from the gifts:
[spoiler]Not much, to be honest! The most "powerful" items you can get from the letters are a Prize Ticket, an Energy Tonic, a Battery Pack, and a Solar Panel. The Solar Panel can't show up earlier than Winter of Y1.[/spoiler]

[b]Version 1.0.4[/b]: Fixed the manifest... Hopefully for the last time. I felt bad about updating the mod three times in one night, so I added another letter so it wasn't another "empty" update. I swear I'm done touching this for a hot minute now!
Old version info under the spoiler.
[spoiler]
[b]Version 1.0.3[/b]: I broke the update key fixing the update key... It is fixed for realsies now, I promise. (I really hope no one downloaded
the broken one in the several minutes 1.0.2 was current... D:)
[b]Version 1.0.2[/b]: Added 5 new letters, fixed the update key (oops), but mostly a backend update to expand my options later.
[b]Version 1.0.1[/b]: Just a quick update, no new content yet. After looking into a couple of reports of people unintentionally getting spammed by mail (funny, I know) I changed where and when the game should do the mail checks. I also made the mail a little bit rarer just in case. You should be way less likely to get a bunch of letters simultaneously now![/spoiler]
